# Doxis is a leading vendor of Enterprise Content Management (ECM) software.

Doxis (formerly SER Group) is a pioneer of the ECM and content services market. The Company’s AI-powered platform and its solutions for business-critical processes automate content understanding across enterprise ecosystems. Doxis serves blue-chip customers worldwide, with over five million users leveraging its technology to make daily work easier.
